params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The pointer to the first record of the set of paginated results. To view the next response, use the `nextCursor` value for this parameter.

items.docs:
Searches Postman for resources such as workspaces, collections, requests, and other resource types. You can filter results by ownership, visibility, tags, and other criteria.

**Note:**

If you call this endpoint without an API key, the response only returns publicly-available resources.
